USE USOnTimeProject
GO
--EXEC silver.USP_Silver_OnTimeData '2022', '12'
/*
    This stored procedure is for creating parquet files in silver layer in adls partitioned by year
    and month folders. This is not a suggested method, but it's an alternative.
    The best approach is to use spark 
*/

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE silver.USP_Silver_OnTimeData
@year VARCHAR(4),
@month VARCHAR(2)
AS
BEGIN

    DECLARE @create_sql_stmt NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @drop_sql_stmt   NVARCHAR(MAX);

    SET @create_sql_stmt = 
        'CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE silver.OnTimeData_' + @year + '_' + @month + 
        ' WITH
            (
                DATA_SOURCE = USOnTimeProject_RootFS,
                LOCATION = ''Silver/OnTimeReporting/year=' + @year + '/month=' + @month + ''',
                FILE_FORMAT = parquet_file_format
            )
        AS
        SELECT [year]
,[month]
,[FL_DATE]
,[OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER]
,[OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID]
,[TAIL_NUM]
,[OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM]
,[ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID]
,[ORIGIN_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID]
,[ORIGIN]
,[ORIGIN_CITY_NAME]
,[ORIGIN_STATE_ABR]
,[DEST_AIRPORT_ID]
,[DEST_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID]
,[DEST]
,[DEST_CITY_NAME]
,[DEST_STATE_ABR]
,[CRS_DEP_TIME]
,[DEP_TIME]
,[DEP_DELAY]
,[DEP_DELAY_NEW]
,[TAXI_OUT]
,[WHEELS_ON]
,[TAXI_IN]
,[CRS_ARR_TIME]
,[ARR_TIME]
,[ARR_DELAY]
,[ARR_DELAY_NEW]
,[CANCELLED]
,[CANCELLATION_CODE]
,[DIVERTED]
,[CRS_ELAPSED_TIME]
,[ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME]
,[AIR_TIME]
,[DISTANCE]
,[CARRIER_DELAY]
,[WEATHER_DELAY]
,[NAS_DELAY]
,[SECURITY_DELAY]
,[LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY]
        FROM bronze.vw_USOnTimeData_CSV
        WHERE year = ''' + @year + '''
          AND month = ''' + @month + '''';    

    print(@create_sql_stmt)

    EXEC sp_executesql @create_sql_stmt;

    SET @drop_sql_stmt = 
        'DROP EXTERNAL TABLE silver.OnTimeData_' + @year + '_' + @month;

    print(@drop_sql_stmt)
    EXEC sp_executesql @drop_sql_stmt;

END;
